quarterly_data.quarter: Doosan Enerbility press release: Doosan Enerbility Wins Contract for O Mon III Combined (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: O Mon III CCGT power plant (Vietnam) contract with state-owned Petrovietnam (PVN), stated at KRW 840 billion: Doosan forms a consortium with PTSC (a PVN subsidiary specializing in energy services), takes on the overall EPC work and will also supply the steam turbine, which the company says will be the first deployment of a Doosan Enerbility steam turbine at a combined cycle power plant in Vietnam. The plant is designed for a total capacity of 1,155MW and slated to be built by 2030, at the same power generation complex as the O Mon IV plant Doosan won last year, approximately 180km southwest of Ho Chi Minh City. SVP of EPC Sales & Marketing Seongyeol Lee: client PVN plans more CCGT plants at the O Mon complex and in North Central Vietnam, and Doosan plans to execute O Mon III and IV to actively expand its reach in the Vietnamese power market.
